title: 09 · Soffit: roadmap forecast (desktop, 1440×900 @2x)
strengths: Card density, label chips, initials avatars and the sidebar sections match Linear and Height at a real 14/12 px scale; one vermilion for today, urgent, due dates and the primary action.
Believable work: FLD-231 'Bulk reassign jobs from the dispatcher map', 'Retry queue for failed photo uploads', a 'Release 4.2' milestone on Fri 17, 'Synced 2 s ago', a named engineering lead.
Own details inside the convention: diamond status glyphs, keyboard numbers on the view tabs, a 3/5 subtask bar on the focused card.
slop_signals: A two-week timeline and a five-column board stacked on one screen: Linear and Jira show one or the other, so the composite reads as a showcase, not a view someone works in.
A permanent keyboard-shortcut footer across the bottom; real tools keep this behind '?'.
Every label chip repeats the same diamond glyph before its text.
fixes: Show either the board or the timeline; if both, collapse the timeline to a one-row cycle-progress strip.
Remove the shortcut footer, or reduce it to 'Synced 2 s ago' and a '?'.
Drop the glyph from label chips, or give each label its own colour dot as Linear does.

references.what: Board with id, title, label dots and avatar per card, sidebar in sections: the anatomy this piece reproduces, with no timeline above it.
Milestone progress lives in a side panel, not in a strip over the board.
Dark board, same card anatomy; no shortcut footer.

pairwise.reference: Linear, project timeline with side panel

round4.pairwise_note: Blind, random sides, same height, no labels. Rounds A to F used a fresh judge per pair; the final render was judged by one fresh judge for all three pairs. The references are Mobbin demo accounts with sparse data, so the test mostly rewards data richness (feedback F-003).
changed: Rebuilt from scratch: the Linear-like Quarry cycle board became Soffit, a roadmap planner that forecasts each project's finish from its own pace (H2 2026, 14 projects in 5 teams).
Renamed everything: Quarry, Kestrel, Field App, Mara Okafor and the rest are gone; Soffit, Whinberry, Martha Quayle and Ngozi Eze are new (NAMES.md, 2026-10-18).
Table columns Closed, Target, Forecast and 'vs target' on every row; bars show plan span and closed issues with 3:1 edges, and a red block only where a forecast passes its target.
No drag state, no shortcut footer, no orange: one petrol accent for today only, red only for late forecasts, neutral selection, one dark button.

Side panel: one display figure (Tue 8 Dec, 8 days past target), closed and pace, checkpoints in order with due and forecast dates, the week 42 check-in and a decision bar (cut 7 issues or move the target).
IBM Plex Sans only, 12/14/17/29 px; British dates; weekdays and every total re-added from the page.
open: The strict fresh audit stays at 3: mostly grey and can read as a wireframe; family resemblance to Linear (⌘K sidebar, Teams list, side panel); small type in a dense panel.
Auditors reversed each other across rounds (bar outlines, today pill, checkpoint slip line), so the owner's eye has to settle this piece.
The gallery index.html and _thumbs still show the old Quarry title, caption and shot until they are rebuilt.
